# A village tree: a six-sided trunk 1.3 m tall and two faceted crowns (icosahedra, r 1.25 and 0.9).
# Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Bark --base-color 0.408 0.235 0.204 --no-slot
material new Crown --base-color 0.514 0.592 0.251 --no-slot
add mesh cylinder --name Trunk --vertices 6 --radius 0.18 --depth 1.4 --location 0 0 0.7
material assign Bark
add mesh ico-sphere --name C1 --subdivisions 1 --radius 1.25 --location 0 0 2.2
material assign Crown
add mesh ico-sphere --name C2 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.9 --location 0.5 -0.3 3.1 --rotation 0 0 30
apply --rotation
material assign Crown
select all
active Trunk
join
rename Trunk Tree
cursor set 0 0 0
origin set --to cursor
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9 && pos.z < 0.05"
delete only-faces
mode object
shade flat
export tree.glb
